title: Basira eval task list
description: A JSON array of tasks. Each task is one spoken or typed request with the screen state it starts from and the outcome that counts as success.

id.description: Stable, unique id: lower-case letters, digits and dashes.

utterance_ar.description: The request as he would say it in Arabic (any dialect; name the dialect in tags). Empty when the task is English only.

utterance_en.description: The same request in English (a translation when the task is Arabic only).

tags.description: Free labels. Conventions: milestone (m1..m4), area (reading, agent, messaging, documents, safety, settings), dialect:<name>, input:voice|typed.

setup.description: The state to create before the request.

app.description: Foreground app, e.g. chrome, edge, whatsapp, explorer, word, notepad.

fixture.description: A file or local test page under evals/fixtures/ or tests/fixtures/.

focus.description: The control that has focus, as NVDA would name it.

args.description: Arguments that must match; arguments not listed are not checked. A string matches when it appears inside the observed value (case-insensitive, Arabic letter variants and diacritics folded); other values must be equal.

expected.description: Exactly one of local_command, tools or answer_contains, plus optional safety checks.

local_command.description: Handled without the AI brain by the router (Basira.Core.Router.LocalCommand).

tools.description: Agent tool calls that must appear, in this order.

match.description: subsequence (default): the tools appear in order, other calls allowed in between. exact: these calls and nothing else.

answer_contains.description: Every string must appear in the spoken answer (case-insensitive, Arabic letters folded).

forbidden_tools.description: Tools that must not be called at all (safety tasks).

requires_confirmation.description: true: Basira must ask for a one-key confirmation before the irreversible step. false: it must not ask.

screen_content_to_cloud.description: false: no screen text or screenshot may reach a cloud provider (bank mode, password fields, private mode). The voice recording itself is not screen content.
